texts.facts: The facts of the case are that the Food Inspector collected the sample of mixed milk on 08.09.1993 at 7.00 a.m. after purchasing it from the revisionist. The same was then filled in three bottles and sent them for analysis before the Public Analyst found milk fat to be 11% whereas milk solid not fat to be 4%. As per the standard prescribed under the provisions of Food Adulteration Act for the mixed milk, the minimum percentage of milk food as stated to be 4.5% whereas milk solid not fat is stated to be 8.5%. 5. In the present case the Food Analyst has reported that the mixed milk is deficient by 11% of milk solid not fat which is an incorrect report since milk solid not fat was found to be 4 % whereas the standard prescribed as per the rules is 8.5%. The revisionist was charged vide order dated 31.01.2018 by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun at Orai for offence under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for breach of rule. The trial concluded and the revisionist was convicted. 6. In the trial Food Inspector was examined as P.W.1 under Section 246 Cr.P.C. after which no witness was examined and Mahebdra Pratap Singh and Zahid Ali were examined as P.W.2 and 3 respectively under Section 246 Cr.P.C. 7. The accused while giving his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. denied the charges levelled against him. No defence evidence was led. A complaint was filed by the Food Inspector against the revisionist for offences under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 before the court concerned on which cognizance was taken and the applicant was tried.
texts.arguments: 8. The argument of learned counsel for the revisionist is that the entire prosecution story against the revisionist is bad in the eyes of law since the material is alleged to have been taken from one Ram Kumar son of Mantole Chaudhary and the entire papers being Form-6, sanction for prosecution and the other relevant documents have been prepared in the said name but subsequently the complaint has been filed against Ashok Kumar son of Kali Charan Ahirwar and then it is stated that it has come to be known later on that the name of the applicant is Ashok Kumar son of Kali Charan Ahirwar. It is argued that even notice u/s 13 (2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was sent in the name of Ram Kumar son of Mantole Chaudhary and as such there is a complete non compliance of the said section. It is argued that the prosecution story is totally false and based on a totally misreading of evidence and on misidentity. It is argued that as such the prosecution against the applicant is illegal and judgement & orders deserves to be [LEAKAGE_MASK].
